title: Astro Portal reactive change signal
description: The `data:` payload of GET /v1/changes. Two SSE event kinds share this contract: `change` (`changeEvent`) and `resync` (`resyncEvent`, the same shape without `domains` — "re-read everything"). The `id:` line of the SSE frame carries the same value as `cursor`; a reconnecting client's `Last-Event-ID` echoes it back. No other event kind, and no other field on either shape, is ever emitted: this channel carries a signal, never business data (no plan id, no device name, no content) — the whole point being that a divergence is always resolved by the existing synchronization doctrine, never by a second merge path riding this wire. A `: ping` comment line (not a JSON payload at all) is sent every 25 s and is outside this schema's scope.
